title: Données historiques de la Statistique générale de France — Recensements de 1851 à 1921
publisher: Statistique générale de la France; ICPSR transcription; Insee electronic tables (12 January 2010)
locator: REC_T256.dbf V21/V114 (1896), V22/V120 (1901); REC_T24.dbf V132 (1896); REC_T214.dbf V89/V78 (1901). libelles_var_rec.dbf specifies the variables.
rights: Source: Insee, 2010-01-12. Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 (Etalab); field extraction, identity mapping and interpolations by WWO.
coverage: Contemporary metropolitan départements, Territoire de Belfort and arrondissements. Overseas populations excluded.

title: Statistisches Jahrbuch für das Deutsche Reich 1902, I.1 Die Bundesstaaten nach Fläche und Bevölkerung
publisher: Kaiserliches Statistisches Amt; digital copy, Universitätsbibliothek Mannheim
locator: Printed p. 1, section I, table 1, Ortsanwesende Bevölkerung; 2 December 1895 and 1 December 1900, zusammen.
rights: Factual population counts transcribed from the 1902 German imperial statistical yearbook. No scanned image is redistributed.
coverage: German Empire within its European census territory; 25 constituent states and Reichsland Elsaß-Lothringen; 14 Prussian subdivisions. Overseas possessions excluded.

title: Chandler Population Data, version 3, chandlerV2.csv (AD_1900)
publisher: Meredith Reba, Femke Reitsma and Karen C. Seto; figshare (2016), after Tertius Chandler, Four Thousand Years of Urban Growth (1987)
locator: chandlerV2.csv, Figshare file 5407640. One-based data records after the header. AD_1900 >= 50,000.
rights: CC BY 4.0. Reba, Reitsma & Seto (2016), after Chandler (1987). WWO selected and normalized the AD_1900 column and added geography/quality labels.
coverage: Urban population estimates compiled for AD 1900. Settlement footprints vary, and geocoding certainty describes location alone. No uniform municipal-boundary or exact census-day interpretation.

title: Modern China Geospatial Database – Main Dataset, version 2.2
publisher: Christian Henriot, Aix-Marseille Université / ENP China, Zenodo
locator: MCGD_Data_V2.2.csv, LocID and NameID. city_chinese_names.csv lists both the Chinese and linked romanization identifiers.
rights: CC BY 4.0. WWO links selected name variants to Reba city records by reported locality and the gazetteer LocID.

title: 2024 Gazetteer Files, national places
locator: 2024_Gaz_place_national.zip, GEOID, INTPTLAT, INTPTLONG. Place codes are cited in the individual quality notes.
rights: US federal government geographic data. Used for coordinate comparisons only.
